text:
sam_g: Quick vendor sync summary — key callouts for marketplace, SI onramp, and public comms. High level: vendors are aligned on dates but APAC Gaudi availability is fuzzy. Need a clear cutover plan and embargo single source of truth.
tia_m: Can you bullet the actionable risks? Marketplace team needs precise staging cutoffs.
sam_g: Risks:
- Gaudi APAC: OEM said "early June" but no firm ship dates — could push rolling availability into mid-June.
- SI certification: partner requests 36-48h lead time after we hand them a signed golden-image artifact.
- Embargo overlap: multiple vendors want press days within the same two-week span 3 legal asked for consolidated embargo doc.
leandro: For Marketplace: we require 72h to stage AMIs/SKU metadata and run billing sanity checks. Earliest safe SLA: signed artifacts in S3 by 2026-06-02 for a 2026-06-05 public listing.
sam_g: Vendors committed to providing images by 2026-05-31 for the first wave (NVIDIA/Hopper family). MI300 vendor targets 2026-06-08. Gaudi still TBD.
tia_m: SI onramp checklist draft (we should circulate):
- artifact: filename + sha256
- supported driver & CUDA/ROCm versions
- example launch config (gpus, mem, batch)
- perf baseline CSV (qps, p95, token/sec)
- rollback tag + contact
- contact matrix (vendor eng, SI PM, our ops)
rachel_legal: Important re: NDAs & demo carveouts 3 we can allow 1:1 demo exceptions but only with our NDA + a signed partner NDA. No embargo leaks permitted; add a demo whitelist.
infra_bot: Calendar event created: "GPU Wave Coordination — Embargo & SI Onramp" link https://calendar.example.com/event/2142599000. Staging bucket: s3://partners-staging/2142599000 (access control pending).
leandro: CI help: I'll add a tiny job to verify golden image SHA on merge. Snippet to share with SI:
```bash
EXPECTED_SHA="${EXPECTED_SHA}"
ACTUAL=$(sha256sum golden-image.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED_SHA" ] || (echo "SHA MISMATCH" && exit 1)
```
sam_g: Press ops asks we publish embargo windows in UTC and keep a single canonical doc. Proposed windows (tentative):
- NVIDIA H100/H200/B200: 2026-06-05 10:00 UTC -> 2026-06-05 16:00 UTC
- AMD MI300: 2026-06-12 09:00 UTC -> 2026-06-12 15:00 UTC
- Gaudi: rolling by region, earliest 2026-06-20 -> 2026-06-26 (APAC dependent)
tia_m: Marketplace reply: 72h staging confirmed but we need assets by 2026-06-02 for the 6/5 wave. If vendors can't meet that, they should ask for a later announcement date.
leandro: SI note: we can shorten the certification window to 36h if vendor provides pre-signed image + driver metadata. Otherwise default 48h.
rachel_legal: I'll draft the consolidated embargo doc and a "DO NOT SHARE" list template. Also prepping an NDA template for demo carveouts.
sam_g: Next steps (owners & due dates):
- leandro: post SI onramp checklist + CI snippet by EOD 2142599200 UTC
- rachel_legal: consolidated embargo doc + NDA template by 2142599300 UTC
- tia_m: confirm marketplace staging buckets & billing SKU mapping by 2142599350 UTC
- sam_g: vendor confirmations (final image delivery dates) by 2142599400 UTC

sam_g: If any vendor requests a private demo before embargo lifts, note in this thread and include which NDA was used. We'll gate approvals to Legal + Product.
infra_bot: Reminder: upload golden-image artifacts to s3://partners-staging/2142599000 by 2026-05-31 to avoid CI gating. Access request form: https://notion.example.com/partner-access.
tia_m: tagging @marketplace-team to make sure billing is on standby.
leandro: Will also add a short troubleshooting checklist for SI: kernel logs path, driver mismatch common errors, and a rollback command.
sam_g: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if Gaudi firm dates change. Keep vendor replies inline so we have a single thread of truth. :white_check_mark:
